subject.title: feat(talk): expose gateway audio to plugins

question: Should native plugins receive raw Gateway Talk PCM only through an explicit, session-scoped capability, and what owner is allowed to mint that capability?
rationale: This is a permanent plugin security and privacy boundary; code review cannot safely choose whether unrestricted native-plugin observation is an accepted product trust model.

options.title: Require scoped media capability
options.body: Bind subscriptions to an explicit capability for a permitted Talk session and reject unscoped observation by default.

options.title: Accept process-wide native-plugin access
options.body: Treat all loaded native plugins as authorized to observe every active Gateway Talk session and document that trust boundary explicitly.

options.title: Pause the API surface
options.body: Keep the implementation out of core until maintainers settle the plugin trust and session-ownership model.

recommendation.title: Require scoped media capability
recommendation.body: Bind subscriptions to an explicit capability for a permitted Talk session and reject unscoped observation by default.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the proposed API and can provide the design context, while broader current-main ownership routing remains unresolved from the available evidence.
